estimates.assumptions: Broad (fava) beans; 2 cups dry fava beans is a standard 400g for ful medames recipes (dry weight before soaking/cooking; recipe cooks in water so this is the input state).
Dash of olive oil interpreted as a modest table spoon (≈15 g) for the whole recipe as a shared dressing component.
3 average lemons (≈110 g each with peel; recipe uses quartered lemons as dressing, so whole fruit weight).
4 typical garlic cloves (≈3 g each, total 12 g).
Sprinkling of cumin as a modest shared amount (≈2 g total for the recipe).
